title: Automation Payback
description: Rank automation candidates by payback before you build: per candidate, monthly reclaimable value (hours saved per week times your loaded hourly rate, plus the error cost the automation eliminates) against total cost of ownership (one-time build, subscription, and a maintenance haircut on recurring cost, default 20 percent). Outputs a ranked table with break-even months and horizon net, keep-vs-skip calls, portfolio totals for hours reclaimed and net dollars, and a verdict naming the best candidate and the fastest break-even. No tool-price database; every figure is a user estimate.
data_vintage: No tool-price database: hours, loaded rates, build costs, subscriptions, and error costs are user estimates per candidate. The only fixed assumption is the maintenance haircut (default 20 percent, editable).
